description: Delete an ABAP function group include from the SAP system via ADT deletion API. Note: function module includes must be deleted via the Function Builder; the backend rejects such deletions. Transport request optional for local objects.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

function_group_name.description: Function group name containing the include.

transport_request.description: Transport request number, not a task. Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects.

name: DeleteFunctionInclude
